subject: Next steps: stakeholder map + procurement gating for Datawave POC

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Jun 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: stakeholder map + procurement gating for Datawave POC

Hi Lena — great conversation today, thanks for walking through the use case and the demo feedback. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum toward the pilot: 

Recap (what we heard)
- Goal: 8-week POC integrating Redwood Inference into Datawave’s search & recommendations pipeline; primary success metric is 25% reduction in relevance tuning time and 15% improvement in click-through rate.
- Key technical constraint: PII filtering on request payloads, US-only data residency for logs, and ability to audit inference requests for compliance.
- Decision timeline: Exec review targeted for the week of July 5; procurement/legal gates need to be complete ahead of that.

Immediate asks / proposed owners
1) Stakeholder map: can you confirm the economic buyer and the legal/procurement contacts? From the call you mentioned Tom in procurement and Priya in legal — can you confirm their emails and whether they need an internal briefing deck? (Lena)
2) Security artifacts: I attached a short SOC 2 summary and a scoped POC security checklist. Ben, can you prepare a 1-page note on data handling and encryption we can share with Priya? (Ben)
3) ROI worksheet: filling the attached ROI-worksheet helps us align on measurable outcomes. I also attached a draft POC scope (RDW-POC-scope.pdf) to anchor timelines.
4) Proposed next meeting: 30–45 min cross-functional call with Tom (procurement) and Priya (legal) next week — please send availability.

Attachments: RDW-POC-scope.pdf, ROI-worksheet.xlsx

Thanks — I’ll prepare an internal champion pack for you (talk tracks, one-pager for execs). If you prefer, we can do a quick run-through with Tom before the procurement call.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 10:15:00 -0700

Stephanie / Marissa — looping in the procurement/security checklist items I mentioned on the call. Draft notes below that I can convert into a one-pager for Priya and Tom. I attached the SOC 2 summary for reference.

Procurement & legal highlights (talking points / evidence):
- Contract / T&Cs: we typically offer a 90-day POC contract with a defined SOW and termination clause. We can include a data-processing addendum (DPA) with standard breach notification timelines.
- Liability / indemnity: for POCs we offer limited liability tied to direct damages; full enterprise indemnities are available on annual contracts.
- Data residency & logs: logs for the POC can be stored in a US-only region; we support per-customer retention policies and can disable retention on request.
- Security artifacts available: SOC 2 Type II summary (attached), pen-test executive summary, and a redacted architecture diagram showing isolation.
- Procurement ask: estimated POC spend band (GPU hours + engineering support): $12k–$22k depending on scale; include optional 10-hour onboarding block.

Champion enablement (talk tracks for Lena)
- Exec hook: "Reduce tuning cycle time by X — frees up engineering to ship product features faster."
- Risk mitigation: "We will run the initial POC in a US-only environment, provide SOC 2 evidence, and define an explicit rollback plan so there’s no vendor lock-in."
- Ask template for procurement: concise SOW + acceptance criteria + exit criteria; attach sample SOW.

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf

I’ll draft the one-pager and SOW sample this afternoon and drop into the drive link for you to forward. If Friday 11:00 PT works, I’ll join the call to handle the procurement technical Qs.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
